items.source: Make sure to use the same data types: @DocumentReference(lookup="{'someRef':?#{#self._id} }") can easily fail when using @Id String id and String someRef as String @Id's are subject to automatic ObjectId conversion (but not other String properties containing ObjectId.toString()). Reference lookup uses values from the resulting Document and in that case, it would query a String field using an ObjectId yielding no results.
items.translation: 确保使用相同的数据类型：@DocumentReference(lookup="{'someRef':?#{#self._id} }") 在使用 @Id String id 和 String someRef 时很容易失败，因为 String @Id 会进行自动的 ObjectId 转换（但其他包含 ObjectId.toString() 的 String 属性则不会）。引用查找使用的是结果 Document 中的值，在这种情况下，它将使用 ObjectId 查询一个 String 字段，从而导致无结果。

items.source: DBRefs can also be resolved lazily. In this case the actual Object or Collection of references is resolved on first access of the property. Use the lazy attribute of @DBRef to specify this. Required properties that are also defined as lazy loading DBRef and used as constructor arguments are also decorated with the lazy loading proxy making sure to put as little pressure on the database and network as possible.
items.translation: DBRef 也可以采用惰性解析。在这种情况下，实际的对象或引用集合会在首次访问该属性时进行解析。请使用 @DBRef 的 lazy 属性来指定此行为。那些同样被定义为惰性加载 DBRef 且用作构造函数参数的必需属性，也会被惰性加载代理所装饰，从而确保对数据库和网络的负载尽可能小。

items.source:
Using @DocumentReference offers a flexible way of referencing entities in MongoDB. While the goal is the same as when using DBRefs, the store representation is different. DBRef resolves to a document with a fixed structure as outlined in the MongoDB Reference documentation.
Document references, do not follow a specific format. They can be literally anything, a single value, an entire document, basically everything that can be stored in MongoDB. By default, the mapping layer will use the referenced entities id value for storage and retrieval, like in the sample below.
items.translation:
使用@DocumentReference提供了一种灵活的方式来引用 MongoDB 中的实体。虽然其目标与使用DBRefs相同，但存储表示形式有所不同。DBRef会解析为具有固定结构的文档，该结构在MongoDB 参考文档中有详细说明。
文档引用并不遵循特定格式。它们可以是任何内容：单个值、整个文档，基本上是可以存储在 MongoDB 中的任何东西。默认情况下，映射层将使用被引用实体的id值进行存储和检索，如下面的示例所示。

items.source: The single document lookup query evaluating placeholders via SpEL expressions using #target as the marker for a given source value. Collection like or Map properties combine individual lookups via an $or operator.
items.translation: 使用 SpEL 表达式通过 `#target` 作为标记来评估占位符的单文档查找查询。`Collection` 类型或 `Map` 类型的属性会通过 `$or` 操作符组合单个查找结果。

items.source: @DocumentReference(lookup) allows defining filter queries that can be different from the _id field and therefore offer a flexible way of defining references between entities as demonstrated in the sample below, where the Publisher of a book is referenced by its acronym instead of the internal id.
items.translation: @DocumentReference(lookup) 允许定义不同于 _id 字段的过滤查询，从而提供了一种灵活的方式来定义实体间的引用关系，如下面的示例所示：书籍的 Publisher 通过其缩写而非内部 id 进行引用。

items.source: You need not use @OneToMany or similar mechanisms because the List of objects tells the mapping framework that you want a one-to-many relationship. When the object is stored in MongoDB, there is a list of DBRefs rather than the Account objects themselves. When it comes to loading collections of DBRefs it is advisable to restrict references held in collection types to a specific MongoDB collection. This allows bulk loading of all references, whereas references pointing to different MongoDB collections need to be resolved one by one.
items.translation: 您无需使用 `@OneToMany` 或类似的机制，因为对象列表本身已告知映射框架存在一对多关系。 当对象存储于 MongoDB 时，其中包含的是 DBRefs 列表，而非 `Account` 对象本身。 在处理 `DBRef` 集合的加载时，建议将集合类型中持有的引用限制为特定的 MongoDB 集合。 这样做可以批量加载所有引用；而指向不同 MongoDB 集合的引用则需逐个解析。

items.source: The sample above uses an _id-based fetch query ({ '_id' : ?#{#target} }) for data retrieval and resolves linked entities eagerly. It is possible to alter resolution defaults (listed below) using the attributes of @DocumentReference
items.translation: 上面的示例使用基于 `_id` 的获取查询（`{ '_id' : ?#{#target} }`）进行数据检索，并急切解析关联实体。 可以使用 `@DocumentReference` 的属性来更改解析默认值（如下所列）。

items.source: The above snippet shows the reading side of things when working with custom referenced objects. Writing requires a bit of additional setup as the mapping information do not express where #target stems from. The mapping layer requires registration of a Converter between the target document and DocumentPointer, like the one below:
items.translation: 上述片段展示了在处理自定义引用对象时的读取方面。写入则需要一些额外的设置，因为映射信息并未表达#target的来源。映射层需要在目标文档与DocumentPointer之间注册一个Converter转换器，如下所示：

items.source: It is also possible to model relational style One-To-Many references using a combination of @ReadonlyProperty and @DocumentReference. This approach allows link types without storing the linking values within the owning document but rather on the referencing document as shown in the example below.
items.translation: 同样，可以通过组合使用@ReadonlyProperty和@DocumentReference来建模关系型风格的一对多（One-To-Many）引用。这种方法允许在引用文档中存储链接值，而不是在拥有文档中存储，如下面的示例所示。

items.source:
A collection of document references is bulk loaded using the $or operator.
The original element order is restored in memory on a best-effort basis. Restoring the order is only possible when using equality expressions and cannot be done when using MongoDB query operators. In this case results will be ordered as they are received from the store or via the provided @DocumentReference(sort) attribute.
items.translation:
使用 `$or` 运算符批量加载文档引用集合。
内存中会尽最大努力恢复原始元素顺序。 仅在使用相等表达式时才能恢复顺序，无法在使用 MongoDB 查询运算符时恢复。 在此情况下，结果将按照从存储接收的顺序或通过提供的 `@DocumentReference(sort)` 属性指定的顺序排列。

items.source: The annotated property’s domain type, respectively the value type in case of Collection like or Map properties, collection name.
items.translation: 注释属性的域类型，对于类似Collection或Map的属性分别为值类型和集合名称。

items.source: An _id field based query ({ '_id' : ?#{#target} }) using the loaded source value.
items.translation: 基于加载的源值使用 `_id` 字段的查询（`{ '_id' : ?#{#target} }`）。

items.source:
Lazy document references are hard to debug. Make sure tooling does not accidentally trigger proxy resolution by e.g. calling toString().
Though technically possible, avoid saving back individual lazily loaded entities obtained via properties of the referencing root.
items.translation:
懒加载的文档引用难以调试。请确保工具不会意外触发代理解析，例如通过调用 `toString()` 的方式。
虽然技术上可行，但应避免保存通过引用根的属性获取到的单个懒加载实体。

items.source: The mapping framework does not have to store child objects embedded within the document. You can also store them separately and use a DBRef to refer to that document. When the object is loaded from MongoDB, those references are eagerly resolved so that you get back a mapped object that looks the same as if it had been stored embedded within your top-level document.
items.translation: 映射框架无需存储嵌入在文档中的子对象。 您也可以将它们单独存储，并使用 `DBRef` 引用该文档。 当从 MongoDB 加载对象时，这些引用会被急切解析，从而返回一个与直接嵌入在顶层文档中时外观相同的映射对象。

items.source: None by default. Result order of Collection like properties is restored based on the used lookup query on a best-effort basis.
items.translation: 默认情况下无结果。 对于类似 `Collection` 的属性，其结果顺序将基于所使用的查找查询尽力恢复。

items.source: If set to true value resolution is delayed upon first access of the property.
items.translation: 如果设置为 `true`，则首次访问该属性时值解析会被延迟。

items.source: If no DocumentPointer converter is provided the target reference document can be computed based on the given lookup query. In this case the association target properties are evaluated as shown in the following sample.
items.translation: 如果未提供 `DocumentPointer` 转换器，则可以根据给定的查找查询计算目标引用文档。 在这种情况下，关联目标属性的评估方式如下所示的示例中展示。

items.translation: 以下示例使用 DBRef 引用一个独立于其所在对象之外的特定文档（为简洁起见，此处同时展示了两个类）：

items.translation: 用于集合查找的目标数据库名称。

items.source: The target collection name.
items.translation: 目标集合名称。

items.source: Used for sorting result documents on server side.
items.translation: 用于在服务器端对结果文档进行排序。

items.source: Resolves properties eagerly by default.
items.translation: 默认情况下，急切地解析属性。

items.source:
With all the above in place it is possible to model all kind of associations between entities.
Have a look at the non-exhaustive list of samples below to get feeling for what is possible.
items.translation: 在以上条件具备的情况下，可以对实体之间的各种关联进行建模。请查看下方非穷尽的示例列表，以了解其可能性。

items.source:
We know it is tempting to use all kinds of MongoDB query operators in the lookup query and this is fine.
But there a few aspects to consider:
items.translation: 我们明白，在查找查询中使用各种 MongoDB 查询操作符很有吸引力，这本身并无不妥。但以下几点值得考虑：

items.source: Make sure to have indexes in place that support your lookup.
items.translation: 确保建立适当的索引以支持您的查找操作。

items.source: Mind that resolution requires a server roundtrip inducing latency, consider a lazy strategy.
items.translation: 请注意，解析需要服务器往返通信从而引入延迟，因此请考虑采用惰性策略。

items.source: A few more general remarks:
items.translation: 再补充几点一般性说明：

items.source:
Do you use cyclic references?
Ask your self if you need them.
items.translation:
您是否使用了循环引用？  
请自问是否需要它们。

items.translation: 不支持使用响应式基础设施读取文档引用。

items.source: 1 Set up the link from Book (reference) to Publisher (owner) by storing the Publisher.id within the Book document. 2 Mark the property holding the references to be readonly. This prevents storing references to individual Books with the Publisher document. 3 Use the #self variable to access values within the Publisher document and in this retrieve Books with matching publisherId.
items.translation: 1 通过将 Publisher.id 存储在 Book 文档中，建立从 Book（引用方）到 Publisher（所有者）的链接。 2 将存储引用的属性标记为只读。 这可以防止在 Publisher 文档中存储对单个 Book 的引用。 3 使用 #self 变量访问 Publisher 文档内的值，并在此检索具有匹配 publisherId 的 Books。

items.source: 1 Mark the collection of Account values to be referenced. 2 The mapping framework does not handle cascading saves, so make sure to persist the referenced entity individually. 3 Add the reference to the existing entity. 4 Referenced Account entities are represented as an array of their _id values.
items.translation: 1 标记要引用的 Account 值集合。 2 映射框架不处理级联保存，因此请确保单独持久化引用的实体。 3 将引用添加到现有实体中。 4 引用的 Account 实体表示为其 _id 值的数组。

items.source:
Lazily loaded DBRefs can be hard to debug. Make sure tooling does not accidentally trigger proxy resolution by e.g. calling toString() or some inline debug rendering invoking property getters. Please consider to enable trace logging for org.springframework.data.mongodb.core.convert.DefaultDbRefResolver to gain insight on DBRef resolution.
Though technically possible, avoid saving back individual lazily loaded entities obtained via properties of the referencing root.

懒加载的 DBRef 可能难以调试。请确保工具不会意外触发代理解析，例如通过调用 toString() 或某些内联调试渲染调用的属性获取器。建议为 org.springframework.data.mongodb.core.convert.DefaultDbRefResolver 启用 trace 日志记录，以深入了解 DBRef 的解析过程。
虽然技术上可行，但应避免保存通过引用根对象的属性获取到的单个懒加载实体。

items.source: Lazy loading may require class proxies, that in turn, might need access to jdk internals, that are not open, starting with Java 16+, due to JEP 396: Strongly Encapsulate JDK Internals by Default. For those cases please consider falling back to an interface type (eg. switch from ArrayList to List) or provide the required --add-opens argument.
items.translation: 懒加载可能需要类代理，而后者可能需要访问 JDK 内部机制。自 Java 16+ 起，由于JEP 396：默认强封装 JDK 内部机制，这些内部机制不再开放。 对于此类情况，请考虑回退到接口类型（例如，将ArrayList改为List），或提供所需的--add-opens参数。
